---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a reproducible SDK or Studio defect.
---

## Versions and environment

SDK/consumer version, runtime/browser version, framework (if relevant), OS family.

## Steps to reproduce

Include a minimal, reviewed example or command and the actual observed result.

## Expected behavior

## Diagnostic report (optional)

Studio: Help → Diagnostics → enable collection → reproduce → inspect → download.
Attach reviewed `banora.diagnostics/v1` JSON and the relevant operation ID/code.
Do not attach original private SGF, names/comments, URLs, paths, keys or raw stacks.
The report contains local usage/timing; attaching it is optional.

## Impact and workarounds

Does the problem prevent opening, editing, saving or resuming? Can it be reproduced
with the sample record? Sensitive security disclosures require a maintainer-approved
private channel; never post private details in a public issue.
